specialRules.ruleFull: The warband hires the same hired swords as an Undead warband. Zombies and Flesh Constructs can never become Heroes through That Lad's Got Talent.
Warriors within 6" of the Mad Scientist may use his Leadership instead of their own.
The Mad Scientist is not affected by psychology, his mind being shattered.
The Thrall causes fear.
The Thrall is not affected by psychology and never leaves combat.
The Thrall is not affected by any poison.
The Thrall treats a stunned result on the Injury chart as knocked down.

fighters.name: Wolfman
fighters.equipment: None. A Wolfman can't carry equipment; he fights with tooth and claw and suffers no penalty for it.

fighters.name: Zombie
fighters.equipment: None. Zombies carry no equipment and suffer no penalty for it.

specialRules.ruleFull: Zombies cause fear.
Zombies may not run, but may charge normally.
Zombies are not affected by psychology.
Zombies are not affected by any poison.
Zombies treat a stunned result on the Injury chart as knocked down.
Zombies gain no experience.

fighters.name: Flesh Construct
fighters.equipment: None. Flesh Constructs use no weapons and suffer no penalty for it.

specialRules.ruleFull: Flesh Constructs cause fear.
Flesh Constructs are not affected by psychology.
Flesh Constructs are not affected by any poison.
Flesh Constructs treat a stunned result on the Injury chart as knocked down.
A Flesh Construct gains its experience for surviving a battle only if it passes a Leadership test.

When a Flesh Construct is taken out of action, roll on the Henchmen Injury table as normal. On a 1-2 it can be repaired for D6x5 gc; if the warband can't pay at once, it misses the next battle and stays on the roster until repaired or abandoned.
Flesh Constructs may not run, but may charge normally.

Roll a D6 for the Bitten each turn; they don't roll while in combat. A Bitten who transforms drops all his equipment but a dagger and suffers no penalty for fighting unarmed.

D6 | Result
1 | Madness: stupidity this turn; a transformed Bitten turns back to human form.
2-5 | Acts as normal.
6 | Transformed: frenzy and Sprint, until a 1 is rolled.

specialSkillsList.name: Surgeon
specialSkillsList.description: Mad Scientist only. He may re-roll one die of a single injury roll of one of his warriors; the second roll stands.

specialSkillsList.name: Alchemist
specialSkillsList.description:
Mad Scientist only. At the start of each game roll a D6 for his potion:

D6 | Potion
1 | Potion of Resilience: +1 Toughness for the game.
2 | Brew of Strength: +1 Strength for the game.
3-4 | Quicksilver: +1 Movement for the game.
5 | Backley's Brew: -1 Strength and -1 Initiative until he passes a Toughness test.
6 | Aberrantius Vigortia: +1 Strength and +1 Toughness. After the battle roll a D6: on a 5+ he is addicted, and in each game he does nothing but brew until he rolls a 6 for his potion.

specialSkillsList.name: Apt Revitalist
specialSkillsList.description: Mad Scientist only. The warband's Zombies gain experience as human henchmen do.

specialSkillsList.name: Lunatic
specialSkillsList.description: Any Hero. The model causes fear and may re-roll any Leadership test.

flags.what: A Horror warband needs at least 3 models: our templates hold no minimum, so it is not imported.
The Wolfman's maximum (M6 WS4 BS3 S5 T4 W3 I7 A4 Ld8) is unlike our Werecreature's, so he takes a new race, Werecreature (Masters of Horror).

The special skills are a new group, Masters of Horror: Surgeon, Alchemist and Apt Revitalist the Mad Scientist's, Lunatic any Hero's, so every Hero ticks Special. Alchemist's potion is a D6 pre-battle roll (prebattle-rolls.json).
The skill table is an image (read from it): Mad Scientist Academic, Speed; Thrall, Werewolf and Hunchback Combat, Strength, Speed. It names the Wolfman Werewolf.
The Miscellaneous Equipment is Heroes only: a third list every hero but the Wolfman (who carries nothing) buys from.
The Chainsaw Sword (15+D6 gc, MoH only; Fear, Shredder) and the Electric Trident (15+D6 gc, MoH only; Zzap!, Shocking, Nail in Boot) are stubs, read as Common and this warband's, their rules on p2.

The Repeater Pistol (25+3D6 gc, MoH only; range 8", S4, Save Mod, Too Much Tinkering, Repeater) is our Repeater Pistol and merged into it (William, 12 Nov 2026), reversing the 6 Nov 2026 answer to keep the two apart: the line buys ours, with a price row for this warband at the entry's 25+3D6, read as Common. Ours keeps its own 6" range and its five rules, so this page's 8" range, Too Much Tinkering and Repeater are not carried.
The Leader rule says "within 6" of the Necrarch Vampire" (the page image shows the 6"; the text layer drops it): read as the Mad Scientist, who leads.
The Thrall's race is our Vampire.

The Flesh Construct's Cannot Run ("may still charge normally") is our shared May Not Run. It gains experience only on a passed Leadership test, so it gains experience but never becomes a Hero. Both it and the Zombies ("Undead creatures") take our Undead race; Zombies gain no experience.
No group sizes are printed: left open, but the Flesh Construct's is 1, as there may be only one.
